The coordinator's decision stands: चरन्तम् and अनपायिनम् carry no anvita (the checker refuses an anvita across genders), and each gloss ends (मिथुनस्य विशेषणम्; अत्र पुंलिङ्गम् आर्षम्). FOR THE HUMAN: decide the gender of मिथुन here. (a) As drafted: मिथुनम् नपुं by the Amarakośa (§5.7 order), with masculine ārṣa qualifiers (masculine by sense, standing for the pair). This is consistent with चारुनिःस्वनम् नपुं, तत् मिथुनं in the vyākhyā, and मिथुनात् (v.10). (b) Or मिथुनम् पुं by Apte (m. also). Then चरन्तम्, अनपायिनम् and चारु-निःस्वनम् are all पुं with anvita मिथुनम्, the ārṣa notes are dropped, and the vyākhyā's 'तत् मिथुनं' becomes 'तं मिथुनं'. The reviewer prefers (a).
